name: VEBus
description: ESP32 Arduino library for Victron Multiplus VE.Bus RS485 communication. Supports ESS power setpoint (with optional battery-neutral virtual setpoint mode), sleep/wake commands, battery/AC data readback, and ESPHome integration. Optional header-only add-ons turn the Multiplus into a network UPS (NUT and apcupsd servers, raw-value scaling). Example firmware adds Home Assistant MQTT discovery, a web dashboard and OTA updates.
